full_page.content:
1948, July 31
The following is a faithful transcription of a message written on a Seraphic Mass Association card by the Servant of God, Fr. Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap.
1948, July 31
Mrs. Regina D. Turner -··- for a speedy recovery, God willing.
Special member
God bless you Mrs. Turner, Do not worry.
July 31st 1948:
God bless you Mrs. Turner. If "courage is half the battle" then with confidence in God it must mean sure triumph -- whatever the natural outlook.
Fr. Solanus, O. F. M. Cap.
c. 1949
The following is a faithful transcription of the typed original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap.
St. Felix Friary Route 8 Huntington, Indiana c. 1949
Dear Mrs. Turner:
Thank you for your kind favor of July 19. I shall pray that the good Lord will grant your intention, if it is for the good of your soul. I do not think that I know Mrs. Jennie Ferreri personally, at least I can't recall her just now.
God bless you, Very Sincerely yours in Christ,
Fr. Solanus, O. F. M. Cap.
